title: NTC restores tower near Trishuli-3A; Betrawati and parts of Kalikasthan back on network
body: Nepal Telecom said 80 of 120 affected sites have been restored. The Tupche BTS resumed on Saturday with a generator flown in by helicopter.

title: NTC restores mobile network in Dhunche and Syabrubesi
body: Goljung tower back on air; Timure hill site still pending.

title: रसुवाका गाउँहरू अझै सञ्चारविहीन, टिमुरे हिलको टावर बन्द
